description: Defines the TransactionTracing class responsible for recording and managing committed transactions in the Android SurfaceFlinger component, including buffering, serialization, and file output of transaction data.

classes.name: TransactionTracing
classes.description: Manages recording, buffering, and exporting transaction data for SurfaceFlinger, including thread management and synchronization.

methods.name: TransactionTracing
methods.description: Constructor initializing the transaction tracing system.

methods.name: addQueuedTransaction
methods.description: Adds a transaction to the queue.

methods.name: addCommittedTransactions
methods.description: Records committed transaction details including vsync, update, display info, and change flag.

methods.name: writeToFile
methods.description: Outputs the buffered transaction data to a specified file.

methods.name: setBufferSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the buffer in bytes.

methods.name: onLayerRemoved
methods.description: Handles removal of a layer by its ID.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Dumps current state information for debugging.

methods.name: createTraceFileProto
methods.description: Creates a proto representation of the trace file.

methods.name: loop
methods.description: Main thread loop for processing transactions.

methods.name: addEntry
methods.description: Adds committed transaction entries to the buffer.

methods.name: getLayerIdLocked
methods.description: Retrieves layer ID from a handle with lock protection.

methods.name: tryPushToTracingThread
methods.description: Attempts to push data to the tracing thread without blocking.

methods.name: addStartingStateToProtoLocked
methods.description: Adds initial state info to proto with lock protection.

methods.name: updateStartingStateLocked
methods.description: Updates the starting state with new entry info.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Waits until all transactions for a specific vsync are added to buffer.

methods.name: writeToProto
methods.description: Returns the buffer contents as a proto trace file.
